digest.component_or_area: completion verifier and plan-review close gate
propositions: When acceptance criteria become invalid due to code changes after the work landed, closing at the original commit ref is a legitimate path but requires documentation.

When acceptance criteria are invalidated by the fix itself (mutually exclusive by construction), there is no commit ref where both the fix and original criteria coexist, leaving no legitimate close path without forced closure or criterion edit.
Auto-generated or unverifiable acceptance criteria cannot be satisfied at any ref, blocking legitimate closure of completed work.
The plan-review close gate's stale-regver check forces re-review of already-executed plans when the criteria registry changes, stranding completed merged work.
